\subsection{Verified equation register: assumptions and limits}
\label{sec:12.verified_register}

The displayed equations were checked within the stated scope; each entry gives the
assumptions under which the check holds and the limits beyond which it does not apply.
Conformance statements are restricted to the displayed equations and the cited sources;
they are not convergence, stability, or source-transcription results beyond the stated scope.

\begin{description}

  \item[\eqref{eq:3.23} (Section~3)] Uncoupled isotropic Navier equation with beta=0 (no thermal coupling). Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: Thermal coupling term retained as negative control in (beta nonzero).

  \item[\eqref{eq:3.24} (Section~3)] Dilatational speed c_p from the uncoupled plane-wave relation. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: Speed formula checked symbolically only; no measurement claim.

  \item[\eqref{eq:3.25} (Section~3)] Shear speed c_s from the uncoupled plane-wave relation. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: Speed formula checked symbolically only.

  \item[\eqref{eq:3.28} (Section~3)] Classical Eulerian total-energy balance with advective flux, derived from mass, momentum, and internal-energy residuals. Checked symbolically by computer algebra.

  \item[\eqref{eq:3.29} (Section~3)] Same balance in divergence form with F_i = q_i - sigma_ij v_j + E v_i. Checked symbolically by computer algebra.

  \item[\eqref{eq:3.30} (Section~3)] Integral form of the same balance over a fixed control volume. Checked symbolically by computer algebra.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.1} (Section~4)] Zero body force/heat supply and the explicit GN-III variable/coefficient map; coefficient/variable correspondence only. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: No negative reduction test applies to this source mapping.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.2} (Section~4)] Linear isotropic thermoelasticity, constant coefficients, local entropy balance, Fourier heat flux, constant reference temperature T0, and first-order perturbations; source-free equation shown. Compared with the printed equation in the cited source. Limits: With beta=0 the equation reduces to Fourier diffusion; with k=0 the thermoelastic strain-rate coupling remains.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.3} (Section~4)] Homogeneous isotropic elastic reference limit beta=0; rho>0, mu>0, lambda+2mu>0. These are not the fully coupled thermoelastic longitudinal mode speeds. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: A nonzero temperature-gradient coupling term when beta!=0, so the uncoupled cp formula is not generalized to the coupled problem.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.4} (Section~4)] Abstract LS heat-flux residual; the tau0=0 Fourier reduction, not source transcription. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: Negative: nonzero tau0 leaves tau0*qdot; it is not the Fourier law.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.5} (Section~4)] Constant coefficients and source-free local thermal balance rho*c_v*Tdot=-div(q)-beta*T0*div(udot), with the displayed Cattaneo law; the algebraic 4.5 form, not historical source transcription or well-posedness. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: That omitting tau_0*beta*T0*div(uddot) leaves a nonzero residual.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.6} (Section~4)] Uncoupled scalar branch beta=0 with positive k, rho, c_v, and tau_0; c_T is the characteristic speed of the principal part, not a general speed for the fully coupled thermoelastic modes. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: Tests the tau_0->0 singular principal-speed limit; Fourier conduction is not assigned a finite hyperbolic characteristic speed.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.11} (Section~4)] GN-II source-free thermal-displacement form; zero integration function after time integration. This does not establish an energy-flux identity or other GN-II variants. Compared with the printed equation in the cited source. Limits: A nonzero time-integration function contributes an additional spatial term; do not use this form for nonzero heat supply or arbitrary integration data.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.14} (Section~4)] Source-free GN-III specialization with the explicit coefficient/variable map; equation mapping only. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: No solution-level equivalence or flux reduction is checked.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.16} (Section~4)] First-order DPL residual; selected LS/Fourier substitutions only. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: Negative: tau_q=0 is not LS; either single lag set to zero leaves the other term, while both must be zero for Fourier.

  \item[\eqref{eq:4.18} (Section~4)] Candidate MGT flux residual; Fourier and LS-type substitutions only, not source identity or admissibility. Checked symbolically by computer algebra. Limits: Negative: tau=0 alone leaves the k* term; k*=0 alone matches LS only when tau=tau0.

  \item[the unnumbered display in Section 4] First-order Taylor truncation in the three independent lags only; dot(v)=T is retained and all second- and higher-order lag terms are omitted.   \item[\eqref{eq:5.4} (Section~5)] Charge-free three-dimensional thermopiezoelectric balance; no free bulk-charge term. Boundary/surface charge cases are outside this equation.
